answer: Audits are entered in falcon, queued in river, and beacon publishes the wait time. A farm of 50 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 65 identities per epoch. A farm of 3618 identities would post 2199 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
